stem: Meena is standing in her school ground in Jaipur. In which situation is the air acting as wind and able to do useful work?

options.text: The air inside a closed classroom on a still day
Moving air that turns the blades of a windmill pumping water from a well
The air around Ravi as he sits quietly under a banyan tree
Warm air trapped inside a covered clay pot

teacher.key_rationale: Wind is moving air that can rotate a firki or windmill and do work such as pulling water from a well. Only option B describes moving air doing work; the other options describe air that is present but not moving, so it is not wind.
